population: All 2118 frozen validation objects attempted. Per-estimator intersection of successful JWST, native NISP, and all six cached methods; same objects in every model panel. Also report the intersection across both estimators and full-denominator failure counts.
fixed: Existing signed Gaussian-weighted moments: sigma 10 target pixels, central aperture radius 25; intensity-weighted centroid with fixed window. e1=(Qxx-Qyy)/(Qxx+Qyy), e2=2Qxy/(Qxx+Qyy). Require positive flux and positive-definite quadrupoles and full valid aperture.
adaptive: Existing GalSim HSM adaptive moments on 105x105 target pixels; guess sigma 10; max centroid displacement 10 target pixels; bad pixels masked, full radius-25 validity required; retain convergence/failure details. Observed distortion e1/e2; no PSF correction.
summary: Component RMSE sqrt(mean_over_objects((delta_e1**2+delta_e2**2)/2)); per-component bias, scatter, fraction with vector error>0.2, diagnostic OLS slopes; HSM log-size ratios. Round-control e1=e2=0 is diagnostic only.
bootstrap: 2000 paired spatial-block draws, seed20261017, equal object weighting, conditional on the common-success sample. Differences are paired RMSE differences; no independent bootstrap comparison.
native: Signed background-subtracted MJy/sr from the original NISP data, central 21x21 native pixels. Pixel step 5 target pixels: fixed Gaussian sigma 2 native pixels and aperture radius 5 native pixels; adaptive fit uses the same angular crop and scaled initial guess/centroid bounds. Native pixel-center quadrature is not identical to resampled quadrature.
masks: Native uses its own validity mask; cached JWST and reconstructions retain their original common-valid mask. Each measurement requires its full central aperture valid on its own grid; compare their common successful objects. No source segmentation, PSF matching, smoothing of images, or model inference.
contours: Native-versus-JWST joint density, separately for e1 and e2 on the fixed-estimator common sample. Gaussian KDE with Scott bandwidth; 401x401 uniform grid over [-2,2] in both axes. Highest-density contours enclose 68% and 95% of integrated grid probability; same density and levels reused in every column. Display limits [-1,1].
gain: 100*(1-RMSE_method/RMSE_native), on identical objects; positive means improvement, negative means degradation. Paired spatial-block 95% intervals with 2000 draws, seed 20261017.
limitations: Observed cross-band shapes, not calibrated gravitational shear or PSF-corrected morphology.
Failure-dependent selection can favour easier galaxies; report success fractions beside errors.
Fixed and adaptive moments use different weights and measure different shapes; compare model rankings within each estimator.
Single training seed and one cached individual diffusion realization; no claim about realization-to-realization shape uncertainty.
One field, validation-selected checkpoints; not independent held-out test performance.
native_input_hash_recipe: Per batch of 32 in benchmark row order: C-contiguous float64 physical 21x21 images then boolean 21x21 validity masks.
